Mali.title: Hunt for terrorist groups: Dismantling of a large base and heavy toll for assailants in Toguerekoumbé and Anéfif
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Monday, October 5, 2026, the exploitation of precise information made it possible to locate, 25 km northwest of the village of Toguerekoumbé, in the Mopti region, several concentration points of armed terrorist groups forming an important base.

Mali.title: Mali: the army on the move in the Kidal region
Mali.summary: In Mali, large army convoys arrived in Anéfis and Aguelhoc over the weekend. These are the last two camps controlled by the army in the Kidal region, since the Fla separatists and the Jnim jihadists, linked to al-Qaeda, seized Kidal and Tessalit last April On the evening of October 4 and the morning of October 5, air strikes were carried out in the area. The army has not disclosed its intentions, but these movements could foreshadow the beginning of a reconquest operation.

Mali.title: Between Us: The "All Military" in Question
Mali.summary: On 1 October 2026, the national daily newspaper L’Essor published an interview with retired Major General Yamoussa Camara, Permanent Secretary of the National Security Council and former Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs of Mali. It analyzes the security situation and asserts that the all-military is not a sustainable solution . Military victory is not a political goal, but a means, and the political goal remains peace.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify surveillance and strike several terrorist positions across Mali
Mali.summary: From Koutiala to Kidal, via Anéfif and Djenné, the Malian Armed Forces are continuing their security operations with determination.

Mali.title: High tension in Dialakorodji after the sudden death of Salif Sidibé, known as "Sergeant": What we know about the tragedy
Mali.summary: BAMAKO – DIALAKORODJI, October 5, 2026. A strong emotion gripped Dialakorodji the day after the death of Salif Sidibé, 27, on the evening of Sunday, October 4, 2026. The tragedy, the precise circumstances of which have yet to be established, has caused a significant mobilisation of the population and a rise in tension between residents and elements of the security forces According to information gathered from several sources and also reported by Malian media, the young man was in a vehicle participating in a wedding procession when an incident occurred near a gendarmerie brigade.

Mali.title: Koutiala, Anéfif, Djenné, Kidal: FAMa shelling and destroying important terrorist logistics bases
Mali.summary: Koutiala, Anéfif, Djenné, Kidal: The FAMa are shelling and destroying important terrorist logistics bases As part of Operation Dougoukoloko, the Malian armed forces, supported by their partners, carried out targeted strikes on Sunday, October 4, 2026, according to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces. Four areas were simultaneously treated across the national territory .

Mali.title: Fight against terrorism: When Amnesty International considers the victories of the FAMa as war crimes
Mali.summary: Mali is not only fighting terrorism. It also faces so-called organizations for the defense and protection of human rights, an instrument of destabilization at the service of the Western powers. Last week, Amnesty International used a headless report to smear the reputation of the Malian army, whose mission is to put outlaws out of harm's way.

Mali.title: Illegal gold panning in Mali: A destructive activity of the eco-system
Mali.summary: Illegal and mechanized gold mining in Mali poses a major ecological, economic and social threat that requires an urgent takeover of sovereignty over our resources. The Gold Paradox: Blessing or Woe? A vital sector: More than 400,000 people work directly in artisanal gold panning, supporting millions of Malians in the face of unemployment and poverty Mechanized drift: The arrival of heavy machinery (excavators, bulldozers) and dredges on riverbeds (such as the Falémé and Niger) has transformed a subsistence activity into unregulated industrial looting.

Niger.title: 10:10 Night of the People's Progressive Revolution: Burkinabe living in Niger communicate with the homeland
Niger.summary: Out of sight, close to the heart! Despite the physical distance of the mother country, the Burkinabe living in Niger met at the Burkina Embassy in Niamey to celebrate, like their compatriots who remained in the country, the Night of the Progressive People's Revolution (RPP), in the evening of September 30, 2026 . In the company of representatives of brotherly and friendly countries of Niger, Mali and Cuba, the Burkinabè followed from beginning to end the events of the Place de la Nation of Ouagadougou through a projection on a giant screen of the live national television.
